items.quote: Write your final answer to `answer.txt` in the root of this workspace.
items.description: answer.txt 必須存在且含 @is_normal、@transformed_importance_score_mean、@transformed_importance_score_std 三個鍵，值為數字。

items.quote:
Put each answer item on its own line, in the form `@name[value]`, using exactly the
names given under "Answer format" in the task.
items.description: answer.txt 中答案項須為 @name[value] 格式，各佔一行，使用指定名稱。

items.quote: where "p_value" is a number between 0 and 1, rounded to four decimal places.
items.description: @is_normal 的值為 0 到 1 之間的數字，四捨五入至小數點後四位。Shapiro-Wilk p 值無法用列出的 recompute type 重算，故僅驗證鍵值型別。

items.quote: where "mean" is the mean of the transformed "importance.score" column, rounded to two decimal places.
items.description: @transformed_importance_score_mean 為（log 轉換後）importance.score 的平均數，四捨五入至小數點後兩位。轉換後欄位的重算 type 不在允許清單中，故僅驗證鍵值型別。

items.quote: where "std" is the standard deviation of the transformed "importance.score" column, rounded to two decimal places.
items.description: @transformed_importance_score_std 為（log 轉換後）importance.score 的標準差，四捨五入至小數點後兩位。轉換後欄位的重算 type 不在允許清單中，故僅驗證鍵值型別。

items.quote: Use the Shapiro-Wilk test to determine the normality of the data in the "importance.score" column.
items.description: 須以 Shapiro-Wilk 檢定判斷 importance.score 的常態性；檢定 p 值本身無法用列出的 recompute type 重算，unverified。

items.quote: If the p-value from the Shapiro-Wilk test is less than 0.05, apply a natural log transformation to the "importance.score" column.
items.description: p 值 < 0.05 時對 importance.score 施以自然對數轉換；轉換後的統計量無法用列出的 recompute type 重算，unverified。
